comparison.objective: Hang two parts on separate moving conveyor hooks before a deadline; candidate commissions a shock absorber through guarded cycles.
comparison.physical_skill: Hook task tests moving-target tracking, eye-over-hook insertion, release timing, and handling two parts. Candidate tests stationary small-tool/fastener manipulation followed by dynamic-response observation and iterative tuning.
comparison.success_condition: Each part must hang freely on its own unimpeded hook for the final second before the hook crosses the mark. Candidate requires two energy-qualified stops without excessive travel, rebound, overload, hard-stop contact, or collar drift.
comparison.reason: Moving-target insertion and timed release do not test mechanical adjustment, locking torque, or damping convergence; conveyor motion alone does not establish overlap.
